newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine election officer shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Philippine election officer shot dead.

text.p: Two men shot dead a Philippine election officer after he refused to give them voter registration forms for the May 1998 presidential elections, officials said on Saturday.

Commission on Elections (Comelec) chairman Bernardo Pardo said the election officer of Patikul town in the southern Philippines was slain in neighbouring Jolo on Friday morning while walking towards a bus station.
Pardo told reporters he had asked police to investigate reports by witnesses that the two unidentified men had demanded voter registration forms before they shot the official.
The Comelec had asked all eligible voters to register by Sunday for the election to choose the successor to President Fidel Ramos. Nationwide registration started on June 14.
Filipinos aged 18 and over have the right to vote, and Pardo said at least 40 million of the country's 70 million people would be eligible to vote in next year's presidential polls.
